title: Yellow Citrusy Thai Tofu Kanom Ko
description: A tangy and springy Thai dish featuring marinated tofu and lardons, served in a lacquerware bowl, with a mediterranean twist, this kanom ko is perfect for a quick and easy meal prep

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, yellow curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and bake in the oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a large skillet, render the diced lardons over medium heat until crispy.
Add the cooked tofu to the skillet and stir to combine with the lardons.
Serve the tofu and lardons in a lacquerware bowl, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Prepare the kanom ko by filling small cups with the tofu and lardons mixture.
Refrigerate the kanom ko for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
